title: Lantern Night · Part 2
idea: One of you said GO: at 2:23 am you climb out the window and follow the fox, footsteps matching yours behind you; in the old forest hundreds of lanterns hang in the trees over your neighbors, eyes shut, smiling; one dark lantern has your name, the fox lights it, the footsteps stop at the tree line and a whisper explains: close your eyes and it can't see you. They're hiding. At sunrise everyone walks home, except the fox, whose lantern still burns alone in the forest.
hook: One of you said GO. So at 2:23 am, you follow the fox.
caption:
Part 2. One of you said GO. 🦊🏮
So you followed the fox into the old forest, with footsteps behind you matching yours.

Hundreds of lanterns. Your neighbors underneath, eyes shut, smiling. And one lantern with your name on it.

Everyone came home at sunrise. Except the fox.
Who is it still hiding from? Tell us in the comments 👇
